name: Vellum
description: Scholarly essay system: deep periwinkle navy field (#2A3870) with warm chartreuse-yellow type (#E8D85C). Italic Cormorant Garamond headlines (italic is default, roman is emphasis). DM Sans body. Courier Prime pin-note in bottom-left of every slide. Dusty teal (#3A7878) sole second accent. Zero motion. Still, quiet, archive-wall register.

bestFor: 创始人反思 / 愿景演讲
